Name: Outfit Studio
Author: hinagiku1306
Description:
[b]Outfit Studio[/b] adds an extensive menu for trying out clothes, saving outfit set, and make your own in-game wardrobe.



[b][size=3]Key Features[/size][/b]

- Browse all clothing items by category, mod, or search
- Live character preview
- HSV color sliders for dyeable items
- Save outfits to a global or per-farm wardrobe
- Organize outfits with tags and filters
- In-game settings menu

[b]New in v2.0.0:[/b]
- Hair customization (idea by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/YOULEYUAN038]@YOULEYUAN038[/url])
- Outfit schedules for auto-swapping
- Edit items/hair for outfit set


[size=3][b]Notes

[/b][/size]The mod will give you [b][u]unlimited[/u] [/b]access to any clothing items in game. There’s currently no roadmap for limiting access to only items you own.
Applying an outfit will [b][u]replace[/u] [/b]all shirt/pants/hat items you are equipping.


[b][size=3]Compatibility[/size]

[/b]Stardew Valley 1.6+
All clothing mods added by CP and JA framework. 
GMCM

[u]Incompatible[/u]: FS clothing items won't appear in the menu.


[size=3][b]How to Use[/b][/size]

Open the mod's main menu with "O" (default key)
[b][size=3]

Installation[/size]

[/b]1. Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
2. Run game using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
